status: Recovered historical candidates; exact paper-ablation identity and runtime correctness are unverified.
adaptations: Extracted the minimal TF32 device/helper/global closure into one self-contained CUDA header; omitted the legacy host benchmark headers and unrelated FP16/prototype functions.
Wrapped recovered names in namespace thff_table7_legacy. Replaced needed preprocessor constants by same-value namespace constexpr constants to avoid leaking macros.
Kept W arithmetic and the original double PI literal; changed the PI identifier to local kLegacyPi to avoid collisions with existing project PI macros.
Added __syncwarp() after the branch global shared-output store loop, before cross-lane shared reads for the final global stores.

Fixed the historical uniform global output omission: retained the i<ept loop and original first-group index, and added a same-column store into batch laneid/4+8 from reg[i+ept] for both real and imaginary lanes. Input/output mappings and core arithmetic are otherwise preserved.
Removed trailing whitespace while preserving executable statements and original loop-unroll directives.
known_limitations: Paper stage mapping is a candidate only: branch and uniform versions also differ in layout and unrolling.
N=64, forward, TF32 raw-bit MMA input behavior, one warp per block, batch a positive multiple of 16. No batch-tail support.
No runtime validation or GPU measurement was performed during source recovery.
The uniform output-coverage correction and branch output barrier are adaptations; they have not been runtime-validated in this source-recovery step.
